statusDefinitions.exact: The weapon page directly provides a complete, internally consistent combo and per-hit timing profile.
statusDefinitions.verified-shared: A complete profile is shared from another weapon and the sharing relationship has explicit source evidence.
statusDefinitions.partial: Some direct timing/combo data exists, but the complete fixed profile is absent or internally inconsistent.
statusDefinitions.inferred: A complete profile is inferred from indirect evidence and is not strict runtime-ready.
statusDefinitions.missing: No usable public attack-profile data was found.
